blocks.title: Damped oscillations
blocks.text: Jab alag alag resistive forces (rukawat wali forces, jaise air resistance aur friction) ki wajah se oscillation ka amplitude ghatta jaye to inhen damped oscillations kehte hain, aur un resistive forces ko damping forces kehte hain.

Hum ne parha ke ideal (misali) free oscillation mein jhoolti body ki total mechanical energy constant rehti hai, jaise mass-spring system, circle mein motion aur simple pendulum mein. Lekin asal zindagi mein air resistance (hawa ki rukawat) aur friction (ragar) jaisi forces energy ko dissipate (zaya) karti hain. In ki wajah se amplitude waqt ke saath aahista aahista kam hota hai aur aakhir body ruk jati hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text:
Light damping (halki damping): energy aur amplitude aahista aahista kam hote hain; body rukne se pehle kai dafa jhoolti hai. Playground ka jhoola is ki sab se achhi misal hai.
Heavy damping (bhari damping): body jhoolti nahi aur rukne (mean position par aane) mein bohat zyada waqt leti hai. Misal: gaarhe tel (thick oil) mein duba pendulum, jis par tel bohat zyada rukawat dalta hai.
Critical damping: body baghair jhoole sab se kam waqt mein equilibrium position par wapas aa jati hai. Misal: car ke shock absorbers.

blocks.alt: Teen curves aik hi displacement se shuru: light damping (halki) ka neela curve O ke gird jhoolta hai aur amplitude ahista ghatta hai; critical damping ka hara curve sab se jaldi O par pahunchta hai aur paar nahi jata; heavy damping (bhari) ka laal curve bohat ahista O ki taraf aata hai.
blocks.caption: Light, critical aur heavy damping (asal graph; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon bodies ek hi jagah se chhore gaye hain. Light damping mein body kai dafa jhoolti hai. Critical damping mein woh baghair jhoole sab se kam waqt mein O par aa jata hai, is liye gari ke shock absorbers isi ke qareeb banaye jate hain. Heavy damping mein bhi jhoolna nahi hota, lekin wapsi bohat aahista hoti hai, jaise gaarhe tel mein pendulum. (Yeh graph kitab mein nahi; yeh syllabus ke 'light, critical aur heavy damping ka graph banayein' wale hisse ke liye hai.)

Misal: ek larki jhoole par jhool rahi hai (Fig. 14.14). Damping ki wajah se jhoola har dafa thora kam jhoolta hai aur aakhir ruk jata hai. Damped oscillation ka graph Fig. 14.15 mein hai. Isi tarah jhoolte simple pendulum ka amplitude aahista aahista zero ho jata hai, aur thartharate tuning fork ko ungli se chhoone par us ki awaz jaldi khatam ho jati hai: yeh sab damped oscillation ki misalein hain.

blocks.alt: Jhoole par bethi larki ke do lamhe, koi dhakka nahi de raha: jhoola khud aage peeche jhoolta aur ahista ahista ruk jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.14: Jhoole ki damped oscillation (kitab ki Figure 14.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: O se waqt ke muqable displacement. Curve time axis ke gird jhoolta hai aur har jhool pichhli se chhoti hai; oopar neeche do dashed curves patla hota envelope (ghera) banate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.15: Damped oscillation ka graph (kitab ki Figure 14.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Car ke suspension system ke shock absorbers (Fig. 14.16) damped oscillation ki practical (amali) application hain. Oonchi neechi, kharab sarak par car spring ki wajah se bohat zyada uchhalti; shock absorbers in excessive oscillations (faltu jhoolon) ko damping se jaldi khatam kar dete hain, taa ke musafiron ka safar aaramdeh rahe.

blocks.alt: Gari ka pahiya (wheel) suspension ke baazuon aur shock absorber se jura hai; shock absorber ke gird coil spring lipta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.16: Gari ka suspension system (kitab ki Figure 14.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Car ke suspension system mein critical damping kyun pasand ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Critical damping car ki body ko baghair jhoole sab se kam waqt mein apni jagah (equilibrium) par le aati hai. Is se car baar baar uchhalti nahi, safar aaramdeh rehta hai aur suspension agle jhatke (bump) ke liye foran tayyar ho jata hai.

items: Damping: resistive forces amplitude ko waqt ke saath kam karti hain.
Light (kai dafa jhoolta), critical (sab se jaldi wapsi, jhoolna nahi), heavy (bohat aahista wapsi).
